name: Between Petals and Blades
source:
The game focuses on different philosophical queries. It poses the questions such as, "What is real?", "Who am I, if I can see myself from outside?", "Why do my desires terrify me?" and "Am I living, or dreaming death already?". This game gives you these questions and you give the answer through your choices. A surreal visual novel about loops, doubles, and the violence of dreams. Inspired by Maya Deren’s Meshes of the Afternoon, this game invites you into a labyrinth of mirrors, knives, and impossible returns.

[From [url=https://kirinoyastudios.itch.io/between-petals-and-blades]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该游戏侧重于不同的哲学问题。它提出了诸如“什么是真实的？”、“如果我能从外面看到自己的话，我是谁？”、“为什么我的欲望让我害怕？”等问题。以及“我是活着，还是已经在梦想着死亡？”。这个游戏给你这些问题，你通过你的选择给出答案。一部关于循环、双打和梦境暴力的超现实视觉小说。受到Maya Deren的《Meshes of the Afternoon》的启发，这款游戏邀请你进入一个充满镜子、刀具和不可能返回的迷宫。

[来自[url=https://kirinoyastudios.itch.io/between-petals-and-blades]Itch.io[/url]]
